(A) Several high stakes litigation came up during the quarter. Full Stay and ZERO pre-deposit was ensured in these matters. 1.TN GST matter of 45 crores – Got full stay 2.Service tax matter of 2016-17 – levy of ST on LF – 26 crores – Got full stay 3.UP matters for 6 years – 11/12 to 17/18 – 25.87 crores – got them quashed and remanded back 4.Rajasthan entry tax litigation – 25 crores – matter successfully remanded back after 10 year litigation 5.West Bengal Tribunal matter – 19.66 crores – got full stay 6.Maharashtra GST demands – 27 crore SCN reduced to 12 crores 7.Telangana GST demand of 3.26 crores – dropped (B) Handled the entertainment tax final hearing related issues very well, with multiple documentation, meetings with Counsel, attending in SC (C) With the amendment in GST, bringing into effect the Invoice Management System, he had the foresight to visualise adverse cash flow impact in monthly GST compliance and we changed the current sale model documentation with a new one, which would mitigate this issue.

Sushant has contributed to all key focus areas of BE deliverables in an outstanding manner in the last quarter. He has been self-driven and motivated to achieve the following :- 1) Cadences for CD 6.0 that has led to 19/20 projects being completed, that addresses customer pain points 2) Execution of CD 7.0 from working with Cust Ops, to obtain the samples to its distribution to participants and synthesizing of the observation to arrive at 32 pain points to be worked upon in the second half of the year for customer pain point alleviation’ 3) For CD NPS 4.0 he has worked with the core teams to formulate NPS targets for 2024-25, drive cadences with Top Management (4 in total to date) that has led to 13 of the 23 actionable being completed 4) He has collaboratively worked with various project team members of CEO projects to provide traction for 18 projects being pursued 5) During the Cyber Excellence engagement, he was a core team member that facilitated the assessment. Over and above this he has worked in a focussed manner in enabling publication of the Promising Practices. All of this has contributed to the organisational objectives and therefore the nomination.

Launch of Tata Play Superhit Serials At all levels, this was a project launched well and doing well despite very many challenges. It has been, at idea level, well thought out and well researched product after much debate between extension of classic TV vs standalone product. Example of good partner negotiation wherein for the first time, star agreed to create launch promos and create conceptual promos every month. Star also created special 1 hours edits of all shows despite the large cost. Overall, product idea, partner negotiations, new experiments in GTM, new formats of slate promos, appreciation by subscribers for bringing this product and great numbers makes this a superhit product of the year. All teams involved has put in wholehearted efforts to make this happen.
